questions.q: 8. In a certain code language, "FAMILY * LONG" is coded as "24", "COUPLE * THE" is coded as "18". What is the code for "OVER * HOSPITAL" in that code language?
questions.s:
8.(c)

"FAMILY * LONG" = 24

Logic : product of no. of letters = CODE

FAMILY has 6 letters, LONG has 4 letters, therefore, 6 × 4 = 24

COUPLE has 6 letters, THE has 3 letters, therefore, 6 × 3 = 18

OVER has 4 letters, HOSPITAL has 8 letters, therefore, 4 × 8 = 32

‘PURGE' is coded as ‘24'

→ (4)2 - 1

→ 16 - 1 = 15.

So, 'PUNY' will be coded as '15'.

questions_hin.q_hi: What is the code for “gorgeous face”?
o_hi: kpr opd
ctr ntj
ctr kpr
Either a or b
questions_hin.s_hi:
“you are so gorgeous” is coded as “ntj kpr yui opj”-----------(i)

“can’t say so are” is coded as “yui bnb ntj icy”-----------------(ii)

“you anything so face” is coded as “ctr opj yui opd”----------(iii)

“gorgeous you to can’t” is coded as “hum kpr bnb opj”------(iv)

From equations (i) and (ii), we get that,

are → ntj

From equations (i), (ii) and (iii), we get that,

so → yui

From equations (i), (iii) and (iv), we get that,

you → opj

From equation (i) and (iv), we get that,

gorgeous → kpr

From equations (ii) and (iv), we get that,

can’t → bnb

From equations (ii), we get that,

 say → icy

From equation (iii), we get that,

anything/face → ctr/opd

From equations (iv), we get that,

to → hum

We get that "gorgeous face" is either coded as “kpr opd” or “kpr ctr”.

questions_hin.q_hi: 1. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में "PERMIT" को "VVLNOG" लिखा जाता है। उसी भाषा में "INERTIA" को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
o_hi: XOYHCZU
questions_hin.s_hi:
1.(b)  तर्क: सम स्थान (2,4,6…) के अक्षरों को विपरीत वर्णमाला स्थिति के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है और विषम(1,3,5…) अक्षरों को +6, -6, +6 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है।
उसी पैटर्न का अनुसरण करते हुए INERTIA को I + 6 = O, N M, E - 6 = Y, R I,  T +  6 = Z, IR, A - 6 = U के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। अत: OMYIZRU सही उत्तर है।
